rank_rule.score: materiality x confidence x relevance, each 0 to 1; changes under materiality 0.1 are dropped; top 8 per window
rank_rule.materiality: size of the move divided by the scale that counts as full (capped at 1); discrete events (a measure starts or ends, a new advisory, a status change) are 1

scales.n34: 0.5 = full: deg C of weekly Niño 3.4 anomaly
scales.cpc_vs: 20 = full: percentage points in CPC's odds of a very strong winter
scales.gatun: 2 = full: feet against Gatún's median for the date
scales.ipc: 0.05 = full: share of the people in IPC Phase 3+ across the El Niño regions
scales.wfp: 5 = full: million added people in WFP's projection
scales.pair_kt: 0.25 = full: share of a fitted crop-pair change in tonnes
scales.confirm: 2 = full: steps on the five-step confirmation ladder

rank_rule.confidence: measurement 1.0, official notice 0.9, agency figure in a curated file 0.8, FoodShield fit or model 0.6, automated extraction pending review 0.5
rank_rule.relevance: fitted harvest tonnes and export measures 1.0, hunger counts 0.9, shipping and pattern confirmation 0.8, forecast odds and lake level 0.7, sea temperature 0.6
rank_rule.window_rule: each window compares now with the newest snapshot at least 80% of the window old; with none that old the window says 'baseline building' and lists nothing
rank_rule.text: sentences are built from the two snapshots' values; the food link is a fixed clause with no figures
